description: This PHP source file defines the 'OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet' class, which extends 'DashletGenericChart'. It is responsible for rendering a specific dashboard chart related to opportunities grouped by lead source in the SuiteCRM application. The class includes methods for displaying chart options, generating chart data, constructing database queries, and rendering the chart using JavaScript and the RGraph library.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget for visualizing opportunities grouped by lead source in SuiteCRM, including options for customization and chart rendering.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configuration options for the dashlet, including selected lead sources and IDs.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart visualization, preparing data and generating the necessary HTML and JavaScript code.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the constructed database query and returns the dataset for charting.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into a format suitable for chart rendering, including labels and totals.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunities grouped by lead source, filtered by selected IDs and sources.
